questions.cardText:
[Botany] What is the name of the tallest grass on earth?
A. Wheat
B. Bamboo
C. Sugarcane
Answer: B. Bamboo, a member of the grass family, is the tallest grass on Earth, with certain species growing up to 100 feet tall.
questions.de: Welches ist das höchste Gras der Erde, von dem manche Arten bis zu etwa 30 m hoch werden?
questions.en: What is the tallest grass on Earth, certain species of which grow up to about 100 feet (30 m) tall?

timeline.labelEn: Christian Luerssen names the bamboo subfamily Bambusoideae
timeline.labelDe: Christian Luerssen benennt die Bambus-Unterfamilie Bambusoideae

questions.notes: Giant bamboos (e.g. Dendrocalamus giganteus, typically ~30 m, one clump 42 m) are the largest members of the grass family.

questions.cardText:
[Philosophy] What is the concept of Dharma in Hinduism?
A. The cycle of rebirth and reincarnation
B. The ultimate goal of liberation from the cycle of life and death
C. The moral and ethical duties and responsibilities of an individual
Answer: C. In Hinduism, each person’s Dharma is determined by their age, caste, gender, and occupation. Accordingly, by fulfilling their Dharma, individuals can contribute to the harmony and order of society and the universe.
questions.de: Welcher hinduistische Begriff bezeichnet die moralischen und ethischen Pflichten eines Menschen, die von Alter, Kaste, Geschlecht und Beruf abhängen?
questions.en: Which Hindu concept denotes the moral and ethical duties and responsibilities of an individual, determined by their age, caste, gender and occupation?

timeline.labelEn: Composition of the Rigveda, where the word dhárman (dharma) first appears
timeline.labelDe: Entstehung des Rigveda, in dem das Wort dhárman (Dharma) erstmals vorkommt

questions.notes: Option A is samsara, option B moksha.
